notes.title: The forgiveness
notes.content:
The most hated part of the game - Save System - just got an update, or rather an alternative option for those who don't want to try really really hard.

From now on when you die you can choose an option to resurrect - in that case, a ghost will take all the items that belong to him and leave you alone. If you want to play in the old way you can simply load the checkpoint.

There are also a couple of small fixed, mostly related to visuals:
- Overall lighting should be improved
- Smoker will materialize fully during summon, not only her feet
- Rake should work as intended and always hit you in the head when you run by them
- And mirrors.... they really worked in a weird manner - they should be less weird right now :)
